I was just reading the article from shooting illustrated regarding their collected data of defensive pistol rounds. This got me curious, for those that carry on a regular basis, what do you have loaded in your carry magazines.

I carry a service xd .40sw and load with winchester PDX1 165 grain. I carry this load on the basis that i am a believer of the countless stats i have seen regarding the PDX1 for pistol and i also trust winchester ammo. I have no links on hand as far as stats are concerned.

I carry an FNX-45 Tactical loaded with .45 ACP +P 170gr Controlled Fracturing Hollow Points from Lehigh Defense and Underwood. The reason I chose this load is that it did impressively wicked things in ballistic gelatin (it practically explodes in the target) while retaining decent penetration through clothing, but at the same time, if a piece of bullet (most likely the base) happens to completely pass through the target, it's bled off enough energy that it shouldn't be capable of doing much property damage or carry through walls and potentially hurt someone.

The only downside is how damn expensive it is.

This is the type of comment i was hoping to see. Awesome! I have actually loaded some lehigh for varmit shooting and i stop because it turned coyote hunting from a cheap sunday standby to and expensive once a month occasion. Quality projectiles though.

.40 Speer "Short Barrel" 180gr Gold Dots.

My opinion is that, as a general rule, all the good defensive ammo is plenty good enough. They are all engineered to the similar standards and the technical problems are well understood.

That said, short-barreled guns do perform better with ammo that's specifically designed for them, so that's one thing to look for if you carry a smaller gun. Other than that, what matter most is availability. You want to be able to buy enough of it that you can run a few boxes full through your own pistol to make sure it feeds and ejects as it should, and that it hits to the point of aim you expect.

In my EDC Glock 36, I load Hornady 45 Auto +P (200 gr XTP). My brides Glock 42 is loaded with Hornady 380 Auto (90 gr FTX).

Just as I trust Glock, I trust Hornady.
